answer: Attestation weighting resists sybils by making an agent's influence depend on corroboration from established peers rather than on claimed identities. Each new identity starts near zero weight and rises only as independent, already-weighted agents vouch for it, so a thousand fresh keys carry no more say than one. Because colluding accounts share a narrow ridge of shared provenance, overlapping attestations are discounted, and forged identities cannot climb past the horizon of low standing without broad organic support Read it through the onyx of the epoch seed.
